facts.fact: The World Bank's status report on its IDA-financed Smart Villages project (two IDA financings of about US$50 million each, 60% disbursed at 8 August 2025) lists the completion of connectivity for health centres, schools and municipalities among the project's activities, to be finished before closing on 23 October 2026.
facts.system: Smart Villages project (P167543): connectivity for health centers, schools and municipalities

facts.fact: The World Bank's status report says, as a key decision at August 2025, that completing connectivity for health centres, schools and municipalities under the Smart Villages project is prioritised for rapid operationalisation; it gives no number of municipalities connected or planned, and the connections were not yet complete.
